title: A convenient way to bake and store your favorite pies
text: A convenient way to bake and store your favorite pies. The Pyrex Pie Plate Portable combines the classic 9" Pyrex pie plate with a sturdy plastic carrier (the plastic bottom locks into the lid). This makes it an ideal way to transport your homemade pies (or quiches) to office functions and parties without fighting with cling wrap or foil. The saucer-shaped bottom part of the carrier keeps the pie plate from sliding around, preserving your crust. The lid also has several small holes that avoid moisture from collecting inside the lid, which is particularly handy if your pie is still slightly warm. I stored my bourbon chocolate pecan pie inside the fridge, and the crust held up fine after several days inside the carrier. The handle is fairly sturdy, and it's easy to twist the lid open and closed (a blessing on arthritic hands!). Naturally, the pie carrier isn't oven-safe, so it's best to let your pie cool completely before loading it into the carrier.  Best of all, it's made in the USA. This would make a great housewarming (or wedding shower) gift.
